turns.prompt: Move Friday strength to Wednesday 8:30 PM, immediately after the 75-minute soccer at 7:15 PM. Keep the 40-minute strength duration.
turns.text:
That would overlap soccer: 7:15–8:30 PM, so strength cannot start at 8:30 PM immediately after it.  

Would you like to move Friday strength to **Wednesday 8:30 PM** but shorten it to fit a later start, or keep the full 40 minutes and start it at **8:30 PM only if soccer ends earlier**?
